titulo: How a tunnel under the sea is built 🌊 (they float it, then sink it)
descripcion: Why you can't just dig under the sea, and how an immersed tunnel is really built: a dredged trench, a gravel bed, giant concrete segments cast in a dry dock, sealed with steel bulkheads, floated out by tugboats, sunk with ballast tanks, joined with rubber gaskets squeezed by the sea itself, and buried under rock. Explained step by step in 3D.
